depth.depth_usd_semantics: lower_bound_of_bracket: a size that cleared the threshold, never the crossing itself. Read `bracket` for the located range and `bracket.meets_precision_obligation` for whether it is within 1% of midpoint; a false there with a wide bracket means depth_usd may understate the crossing by the bracket's width.

baseline_rung.quote_expiry_basis: KyberSwap's route response supplies a generation timestamp but no validity deadline. The route is indicative until transaction calldata is built; re-quote immediately before execution.

rung_set.termination_note: Ascending the decade grid stopped at the first rung past the threshold. A SHORT LADDER IS THE ANSWER, NOT A GAP: continuing upward buys nothing once the crossing is bracketed.

depth.slippage_convention: Signed average execution-rate return minus the lowest valid successful decade-rung return (>= $1,000); standing spread and gas separate; not an adjacent-rung derivative.
depth.basis: The -200bps crossing is BRACKETED between 1,000,000 (clears at -1.96bps) and 10,000,000 (-5125.61bps). Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown.

quote.method: KyberSwap GET /api/v1/routes exact-input fxUSD -> USDC; single-hop through Curve USDC/fxUSD to ~$4M, then the router splits through msUSD/alUSD/reUSD and their own onward USDC legs, all priced end-to-end
quote.resolution: Both tokens are exact addresses. Returned route venues are enumerated from router responses, never selected by ticker or guessed pool keys.

failure_reporting.note: A failed rung carries `failure_kind` and `http_status`. `no_route_found` is a finding ABOUT THE ASSET; every other kind is our instrument failing, and the two must not be read as the same claim.

retry_policy.failure_semantics: A transient upstream failure becomes quote_failed only after all attempts fail. no_route_found is not retried because it is a venue finding. Failures are never interpolated or treated as zero liquidity.

quote.reference_rule: lowest valid successful decade rung >= $1,000; no separate micro probe

venue_enumeration.method: union of address-keyed router routes returned across tested sizes

holdings.semantics: Distribution, NOT a bound on depth: how much of the supply is held outside the quoted pool right now.
holdings.lp_withdrawal_caveat: Newly minted supply in users' hands would sell at the depth shown. Supply freed by an LP withdrawing from the quoted pool would NOT: that raises float and shallows the pool at the same time.
holdings.basis: How little reaches the market is a separate fact from depth: at most $41,300,758 sits outside curve USDC/fxUSD pool 0x5018BE88.

primary_exit.gated_basis: riskAnalyst measured 2026-09-22: redeem(address,uint256,uint256) reverts ErrorRedeemNotAllowed() from a holder of 77.1M fxUSD on both the wstETH and WBTC pools, against a clean negative control. NOT re-derived here.
primary_exit.gate: Redemption disabled at the protocol level for holders.
primary_exit.capacity_basis: Zero holder redemption capacity while ErrorRedeemNotAllowed holds. This is primary-redemption capacity, not secondary-market depth.
primary_exit.note: With the protocol exit refused, the secondary ladder in `depth` is the whole exit. A normal payload scores the worse of two operands; here there is one.

enumeration.live_venue_count_basis: Derived from venues[].is_live. The per-venue field is the single source; this integer is a convenience and cannot disagree with it. ⚠️ 4 venue(s) carry no established verdict, so this is a FLOOR of confirmed-live venues, not a total. An unestablished venue is UNKNOWN, not dead.

venues.name: USDC/fxUSD
venues.depth_role: THE exit. Single-hop route for every size through ~$4M; its USDC side (4,166,489 at the pinned block) is the binding inventory. Alone it crosses 2% at [$4,112,500 - $4,150,000].
venues.liveness_basis: Quoted directly via get_dy at block 26031636 and by the router at every rung; USDC 4,166,489 / fxUSD 5,837,210 read on-chain.

venues.name: reUSD/fxUSD
venues.depth_role: Exits into reUSD, which then needs its own hop; the router did NOT route through it at any tested size up to $20M.
venues.liveness_basis: Not established: holds real inventory per the Curve API but the router never selected it, and it was not quoted directly. Unknown, not dead.

venues.name: USDnr/fxUSD
venues.depth_role: Exits into USDnr; never selected by the router; 24h volume 0 per GeckoTerminal.
venues.liveness_basis: Not established: not quoted directly and never routed through. Unknown, not dead.

cross_checks.note: Block-pinned on-chain reads and repeat draws that validate the router figure. All at the pinned block unless stated.

single_pool_crossing.method: Curve get_dy(1,0,dx) bisected to <=1% of midpoint, deterministic
single_pool_crossing.reading: The primary pool ALONE crosses 2% at [$4,112,500 - $4,150,000]. The router's secondary venues add ~$150K of 2%-clearing capacity (about 3.7%) on top of it.

router_vs_single_pool.basis: Router output equals single-pool get_dy to the cent at every size through $4.0M (single-hop); divergence begins at $4.1M when the router opens msUSD/frxUSD paths.

non_monotonic_zone.reading: Above the crossing the router's split heuristic adds a third venue discretely, so cost re-approaches the threshold (-208 at $4.35M) without re-clearing it. This is a routing artefact, not additional depth: every tested size >= $4.275M crosses. It is why the engine's first refinement failed validation and was salvaged from the search's own probes.

cross_checks.inventory_reading: Router proceeds plateau at ~$4.65M USDC: $4.17M is the primary pool's USDC side; the remainder is what the secondary stable pools can absorb on their fxUSD side (msUSD 449K, alUSD 134K, GHO 79K, frxUSD 66K, eUSD 21K) before onward USDC legs that are themselves deep (crvUSD/USDC 5.7M, custodian 255K). The plateau sits inside enumerated inventory; it is not a routing artefact. Past it the router sells fxUSD for ETH.

excluded_liquidity.lp_wrapper_reason: Wrap the same Curve LP; DefiLlama lists them as separate rows.
non_swap_entries: f(x) Stability Pool 0x65C9A641... (77.3M fxUSD, 90.6% of supply)
excluded_liquidity.non_swap_reason: Holders that are not venues. The Stability Pool is deliberately NOT counted as non-float for the supply cap: fxSAVE redeems from it on demand, so it is float that has not moved yet.

axis_binding_constraint.basis: Protocol redemption is refused, so the located secondary crossing is the axis, with nothing beneath it. Depth to 2% is ~$4.27M against a $20.1M redeemable stress size (Morpho's 27% of fxSAVE).
